brief:
The user likes horror and action movies, citing guns, action, and excitement as appealing. They did not give a separate reason for liking horror. Saving Private Ryan is one of their favorite movies because they consider it an epic depiction of World War II.

They dislike musicals because they find them annoying and prefer movies whose themes are not conveyed through singing. They disliked Ghostbusters (2016), confirming the interviewer’s suggestion that it did not live up to the original; they gave no further reasons.

They have seen Star Wars: The Last Jedi and described it as fantastic, saying they loved the spaceships and all the Star Wars characters.
